checks.text: The page displays the heading "Flowchart Editor" and the canvas area is visible with the default tool "Select" active in the toolbar.

Clicking the "Rectangle" button in the toolbar, then clicking and dragging on the canvas from (100, 100) to (200, 150), creates a rectangle shape; the "Layers" panel shows a new item labeled "Rectangle 1".
With "Rectangle 1" selected in the Layers panel, typing "Start" in the field labeled "Label" and pressing Enter updates the shape's visible text to "Start"; the Layers panel item updates to "Start".

Clicking the "Ellipse" button in the toolbar, then clicking and dragging on the canvas from (300, 100) to (400, 150), creates an ellipse shape; the "Layers" panel shows a new item labeled "Ellipse 1".
Selecting "Start" in the Layers panel, clicking the "Delete" button, removes the shape from the canvas; the "Layers" panel no longer contains "Start" and shows "No layers" if it was the only item.
With "Ellipse 1" selected, clicking the "Color" swatch in the toolbar, selecting the red color option, changes the shape's fill color to red; the "Color" swatch in the toolbar displays red.
Clicking the "Export" button in the toolbar opens a menu; clicking "PNG" triggers a download of a file named "flowchart.png".
After creating "Start" (Rectangle) and "End" (Ellipse), reloading the page shows both shapes on the canvas and the "Layers" panel lists "Start" and "End".
